query: 平等机会措施 平等机会措施 衡量企业在招聘、晋升及培训选拔过程中，为确保所有员工/候选人获得平等机会而设立的流程标准及量化监控机制。 一、内容质量得分 • 2分（卓越）：具备标准化的公平评估流程（如：结构化面试、匿名简历筛选、多元化评审委员会）；设定了具体的公平性监控指标（如：女性在关键岗位晋升中的提名率）；且定期审计流程中的潜在偏差。 • 1分（合格）：有明确的公平准则说明，具备基础的公开招聘/竞聘流程及员工培训选拔标准，但缺乏深层的偏差纠正工具或量化的公平监控指标。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关公平措施披露，或仅有笼统的“机会均等”声明。 平等机会 公平招聘 结构化面试 匿名简历 多元评审委员会 晋升提名率 薪酬平等 流程偏差审计 公开竞聘 equal opportunity fair recruitment structured interview blind CV screening diverse interview panel promotion nomination rate pay equity process bias audit open competition 招聘、晋升或培训选拔是否有明确公平准则、公开招聘/竞聘流程或统一选拔标准？ 是否采用结构化面试、匿名简历筛选或多元评审委员会？ 是否设定女性关键岗位提名率、晋升率或薪酬平等等监控指标？ 是否定期审计并纠正选拔流程中的潜在偏差？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '平等机会措施'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 招聘、晋升或培训选拔是否有明确公平准则、公开招聘/竞聘流程或统一选拔标准？ 是否采用结构化面试、匿名简历筛选或多元评审委员会？ 是否设定女性关键岗位提名率、晋升率或薪酬平等等监控指标？ 是否定期审计并纠正选拔流程中的潜在偏差？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有反歧视原则声明而无流程工具；仅有灵活办公；仅有员工满意度调查；仅有多元化人数占比而无选拔公平机制；区分：平等机会措施强调选拔流程与量化公平监控；反歧视政策强调禁止歧视规则；培训百分比是结果统计，不能单独证明存在公平选拔机制。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Merit-based Remuneration and Promotion
results.text: The Group strictly follows labour laws and regulations in areas where it operates and prohibits any form of child labour or forced labour. To prevent forced labour, the Group properly regulates employees' working hours and rest periods. We would never force employees to work against their wills with violence or intimidation, or by restricting their freedom. To avoid child labour, the Group requires candidates to provide proof of identity and candidates without a valid identity proof would not be considered. In case of child labour and forced labour are discovered, the Group will take immediately actions to stop such from happening.

results.text: The Group issues the Implementation Guide of Talent Development and Management to establish mentorship programme for new recruits. results.section: Environmental Protection / Employing Electrical Machinery
results.text: Aiming to achieve environmental improvements, the Group looks into every possibility for energy saving and emissions reduction during our business operation. The Group implemented multiple energy conservation initiatives, such as promoting energy conservation behaviour in the workplace and adopting energy-efficient equipment. The Group also regularly inspects and maintains the conditions of the machinery, vehicles, ferries and vessels in order to ensure that they are operating at optimum conditions. In addition, we assign dedicated personnel for energy consumption monitoring and recording to identify anomalies.
